response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avgs AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM per) SELECT AVG(per.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(per.share) AS avg_share, AVG(per.share - avgs.avg_share) AS avg_share_above_average FROM per CROSS JOIN avgs WHERE per.share > avgs.avg_share
